review_comments: this is pretty twisty... I wouldn't have expected this to be necessary... what is omitting the local flag from the usage text? do we need to fix something about our help template?

when you use `cmd.Flags().StringArray("user", []string{}, "Usernames to bind to the clusterrole")` , the `--user Usernames to bind to the role` flag not in localFlags but in Flags(), because InheritedFlags() has `--user The name of the kubeconfig user to use`.
Flags() contains all flags, some of which are undesirable for subcommands. modifying the template does not work, only let `--user Usernames to bind to the role` appears in LocalFlags().

Follow code also can work
```
+ cmd.LocalFlags().StringArray("user", []string{}, "Usernames to bind to the clusterrole")
cmd.Flags().StringArray("user", []string{}, "Usernames to bind to the clusterrole")
```
